北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感舒适 24℃，湿度较高，出门记得带伞哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing with a comfortable 24℃ feel. High humidity, so carry an umbrella!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云体感 30℃，湿度 88%，天气闷热，及时补水很关键。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, feels like 30℃ with 88% humidity. It's muggy, so staying hydrated is key.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云体感 31℃，湿度 80%，户外活动记得防晒，多喝水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 80% humidity. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen outdoors.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云体感 31℃，湿度 90%，闷热感强，及时补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 90% humidity. It's muggy, so drink plenty of water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云体感 32℃，湿度 85%，天气炎热，请注意防晒防暑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels like 32℃ with 85% humidity. It's hot, so protect yourself from sunstroke.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云体感 30℃，风力 3级，气温适中，注意防风和补水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like 30℃ with a moderate breeze. Mind the wind and hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云体感 30℃，湿度 91%，闷热感较强，记得及时补水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 30℃ with 91% humidity. It's quite muggy, remember to hydrate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 29℃，天气微凉，出门记得带件外套哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 29℃, a bit cool. Remember to bring a jacket when you go out!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感 31℃，湿度 99%，闷热感强烈，请注意防暑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 99% humidity. It's very muggy, so stay cool!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感 31℃，注意防晒，湿度适中，保持好心情。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 31℃. Pay attention to sun protection and enjoy the day.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 36℃，非常炎热，请务必防暑，多补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 36℃, extremely hot. Be sure to prevent heatstroke and hydrate!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云体感 23℃，湿度 95%，出行记得带伞，早晚微凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels like 23℃ with 95% humidity. Bring an umbrella, it's cool in the mornings and evenings.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 26℃，湿度 98%，有点闷，记得保持清爽。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels like 26℃ with 98% humidity. It's a bit stuffy, stay refreshed.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感 17℃，气温微凉，湿度高，注意添衣保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels like 17℃. It's a bit cool with high humidity, so dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 30℃，湿度 91%，风力 3级，注意防潮和防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels like 30℃ with 91% humidity and a moderate breeze. Mind the dampness and wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天体感 26℃，风力 4级，风较大，出门记得带外套哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast and feels like 26℃ with strong winds. Bring a jacket when you go out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天体感 28℃，湿度 85%，天气有点闷，记得保持清爽。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and feels like 28℃ with 85% humidity. It's a bit stuffy, stay refreshed.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，体感 30℃，湿度 97%，能见度低，出行注意安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy, feels like 30℃ with 97% humidity. Visibility is low, travel safely!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴热体感 32℃，湿度 97%，注意防暑补水，保持清爽。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 32℃ with 97% humidity. Stay cool and hydrated!
